gaps.topic: Partial-gravity (lunar 0.166 g / Martian 0.38 g) combustion outcomes
gaps.detail: The PSI corpus does not provide validated lunar/Mars combustion outcome data. Microgravity data are not direct lunar/Mars validation. FLEX model guard rejects > 0.02 g.

gaps.topic: 2,393 historically indexed research media binaries (batches B-20261109-001..004)
gaps.detail: Original uploaded batch archives are not available in this environment. The platform uses authentic NASA Images API media with per-item provenance instead, and displays this gap honestly.
Main bundled records are test-condition/planning inventories; measured spread-rate labels do not exist in these tables. Do not infer outcomes.
Labels identified as copy-down/categorical data-integrity errors; resolution requires source references, not regex guesses.
PSI-100 table contains a two-row summary; must not be inflated to the number of flight tests.
Missing values must not be replaced by zero unless source semantics establish true absence; they are excluded from model features when unknown.

gaps.topic: Labelled flame-image masks for computer-vision training
gaps.detail: No annotated segmentation masks exist in recovered public assets. CV models are therefore NOT trained or claimed (spec deep-learning policy).

gaps.topic: PDE/field data for physics-informed neural operators
gaps.detail: Sparse flat CSVs do not provide the mesh/time field data required for PINN/FNO training; no simulation is claimed.
Model output is an uncalibrated relative score; calibration requires independent reproduction (isotonic/Platt on held-out groups) before any probability claim.
No validated simulator configuration is registered; NASA rows are never inflated with synthetic data (spec rule).
